t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the gnomes come in colour pairs so you pick between the two colours and that doesnt change. each one of a pair will take you to a different forest. you need to try and pick the gnome/fforest that will give you the most mushrooms to reach a higher score. the multiplier at the start of a round 1x or 5x is random and changes every time

vb_textbox.text: it would seem that blue,red,orange and green yeild the higher score with a 5x multiplier. pink,brown,purple and yellow have a higher score with the 1x multiplier.
